name: Omega-3 DHA-Dominant
summary: DHA supports brain development and may modestly benefit cognition.
description: DHA supports neural membrane structure and signaling; may modestly improve cognition by influencing inflammation resolution and synaptic function.
mechanisms: Gene Expression Modulation via Nuclear Receptors
safetyNotes: Mild gastrointestinal effects may occur. Higher-dose, long-term marine omega-3 trials show an atrial-fibrillation signal; clinically significant bleeding is not established at common studied doses.
